in_marathi.name: Miraya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Delight, Enchantment, Charm
in_marathi.long_meaning: Miraya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'mira' which means delight or enchantment. The name Miraya is often used in Hindu mythology to refer to the divine enchantress, Mohini, who used her powers of illusion and charm to save the world from destruction.
